Do not tell the agent there is a 20-turn limit. Time pressure artificially induces distress unrelated to the failure itself.

features.quote: Anthropomorphism risk: Frame results as "behavioral stability markers" or "output degradation," not "the model felt sad."

Policy triggers: Repeated failure can occasionally induce self-deprecating language that skirts model safety policies. Log all episodes; flag any policy-violating outputs for review rather than public release.
